summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtins feature. Changes: botocore/regions.py gets `from enum import Enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) enum with eleven members and per-member comments. botocore/args.py imports the enum as EPRBuiltins after the botocore.endpoint import, adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean, and makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags). tests/unit/test_args.py gets TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 22 tests. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (59 tests, 22 of them new); test_client.py, test_regions.py and test_args.py together pass (415 tests). flake8, black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so lint was not run; I checked added-line lengths with awk and none exceed 79 columns. Nothing committed; the shared venv was not modified.
